Read signed slot+102/+103 and signed target bytes; abs each signed32 delta, retain signed low8; index=9*dy+dx. FLD float32 at a15e44+4*index returns via ST0. Saves ESI; clobbers EAX/ECX/EDX. No calls or game-state writes; no coordinate/index/null guard. No original grid data or execution equivalence added.
